zh: 左侧狭窄笔画组有一条中央笔干和斜向侧分支。
其下部笔画弯曲后在图像下方附近结束。
右侧笔画组上部有一个位于顶端横帽下方的闭合浅色开口。
多条长斜向笔画在右侧组内围出开放的三角区域。
右侧组下方有几条分离伸出的笔画。
最左边缘沿线分布着多个分离的小型残片。
en: A narrow left group has a central stem with a diagonal side branch.
Its lower stroke bends before ending near the lower image.
The right group has an upper closed pale opening below a top cap.
Long diagonal strokes form an open triangular area in the right group.
Several lower strokes project separately from the right group.
Small detached fragments are distributed along the far left edge.
These observations describe visible marks only; no component, variant, or reading is assigned.
